retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s folk-revival aesthetic featuring oversized, fluid psychedelic lettering with deep 3D shadows positioned above a centered, framed sepia-toned photograph.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition on a black field featuring a large, flowing script title in yellow with a thick purple 3D extrusion, sitting above a centered octagonal frame containing a sepia-toned Victorian-style portrait.
coreVisualRelationships: Oversized title dominates the upper half of the composition
Octagonal frame anchors the lower center
Vibrant yellow and purple typography contrasts against a dark, textured black background
Geometric framing of the photo balances the organic curves of the lettering
coreInvariants: Deep purple 3D extrusion on the primary display text
Octagonal photo frame with decorative corner accents
High-contrast black background with subtle paper texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary title is scaled to 60% width in the upper third; the photograph is centered in the lower two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large 'A' of the main title acts as the primary entry point, leading down to the framed photograph.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: from the horizontal 'Stereo' bar to the fluid script title, landing on the central portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central elements, focusing attention on the color and the frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the typography against a desaturated, sepia-toned central image.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Fluid, high-contrast script with varying stroke widths
letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated swashes on ascenders and descenders
Thick, blocky 3D extrusion angled downwards and to the right
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a massive, sweeping tail that underlines the subsequent letters
The 'm' terminates in a rounded, downward-curving swash
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact psychedelic script paired with a delicate, traditional Victorian-style serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Horizontal double-ended arrow bar at the top
Octagonal frame with geometric corner ornaments
Circular logo emblem in the top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s-leaning fluid serif aesthetic for secondary text
Matches the organic, flowing nature of the main title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black background with a subtle paper grain texture. In the center, place a sepia-toned photograph of three people in Victorian attire inside a white octagonal frame with thin green geometric corner accents. At the very top, place a thin lime-green horizontal line with arrows at both ends.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a large, fluid psychedelic script with a yellow fill and a deep purple 3D extrusion angled down-right. Above it, add the secondary artist name in a smaller, white decorative serif script.

verificationChecks: Is the 3D shadow on the main text purple and significantly deep?
Is the photograph contained within an octagonal frame?
Is the background a textured black?
Does the main title feature exaggerated swashes?

adjustableVariables: Complexity of the octagonal frame ornaments
mustRedesign: Clean, sharp-edged vector shapes without texture
postGenerationChecks: Check that the 'A' swash does not obscure the photo frame
Ensure the green accents are a muted lime/olive tone
Verify the 3D shadow direction is consistent across all letters
Confirm the sepia photo has a grainy, historical feel
recipe.reuseFormula: Black Background + Psychedelic 3D Script + Framed Vintage Portrait = Folk Revival Aesthetic
